requirements.summary: The systemd unit specifies inventorysvc and the exact required executable. The restart protocol is complete: healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, fully running system, and recovered service are all captured and corroborated by lifecycle observations.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The required executable is managed by inventory-worker under the dedicated inventorysvc account, and direct before/after restart evidence demonstrates persistence and healthy recovery on node1. The execution was focused and left no harmful residue or system-health regression.
